title: Untitled (Diptych Installation View)
description: Gallery photograph showing two large framed collages hung side by side on a grey wall. Both works share vocabulary of top-down warplane silhouettes, concentric target rings, red geometric lines, and dense ink drawing on white grounds, the right panel considerably more layered and saturated than the left.
